correctness.rationale: On a smooth complex plane cubic with flex origin O, E[9] minus E[3] is the 72-point set T=(Z/9)^2 minus 3(Z/9)^2. Abel's divisor criterion and the cubic restriction exact sequence establish a unique conic through a distinct six-subset precisely when the group sum is zero. Character orthogonality gives [C(72,6)+8*(-1101)+72*6]/81=1,928,772 zero-sum six-subsets. Independent exact group dynamic programming recovered 1,928,772. The 72-point group yields exactly 720 unordered distinct zero-sum triples, 30 through every point; independent enumeration confirmed those, and the 632 disjoint partner lines per trisecant. Unordered pairs of disjoint trisecants give exactly 227,520 unique reducible conics (independently enumerated); subtraction gives 1,701,252 smooth conics, 160,731 all/18,960 reducible/141,771 smooth incident per point. The geometric argument, not finite numerical coincidences, identifies group subsets with distinct curves. No characteristic-p version or conic parameter-scheme claim is made.
